research_objective: Evaluate how different prompting strategies influence the preservation of Information Integrity and Cultural Fidelity when transforming high-context investigative journalism.
research_question: How do different prompting strategies influence Information Integrity and Cultural Fidelity during AI-assisted transformation of high-context investigative journalism?
hypothesis: Prompt strategies emphasising brevity, engagement, or international adaptation will preserve core facts while increasing contextual loss, attribution loss, framing shifts, and cultural simplification.
experiment_rationale: Holds source, system prompt, model, and temperature constant while varying the editorial prompt strategy across four conditions.

transformation_task.name: Faithful Transformation
transformation_task.instructions: Produce a concise news summary preserving factual accuracy, attribution, quoted statements, uncertainty, institutional context, and culturally significant details.
